w: In the morning, Swamishri blessed the Lt.Governor of New Delhi, Shri Kapoor, at the Akshardham site. Thereafter Swamishri inaugurated the crane by performing puja.
In the evening, the renowned scientist Shri Abdul Kalam arrived at Swamishri's residence. The humble Mr Kalam sought the blessings of Swamishri and an interesting spiritual dialogue followed.

At 11.00 a.m., Swamishri visited the Shri Jagannath Jagdish Mandir in Jamalpur, Amdavad, at the invitation of Mahant Rameshwardasji. It was the eve of the 126 annual rath yatra festival. On Swamishri's arrival, 18 decorated elephants raised their trunks and honored Swamishri. The managing trustee of the mandir garlanded Swamishri and led Swamishri to perform pujan of the three raths (chariots) in which the murtis of Bhagwan Jagannath, Subhadraji and Baldevji would be paraded on the streets of Amdavad. As Swamishri entered the Jagannath Mandir the elephants raised their trunks, trumpeted and offered garland to honor him. Thereafter Swamishri offered pujan to a decorated cow called Ganga and then went to the seat where Mahant Rameshwardasji was seated before a fireplace (dhuni). The Mahant welcomed and honored Swamishri. After applying the holy ash to Thakorji Swamishri applied it on his forehead. Then both the Mahant and Swamishri went to the mandir sanctum for darshan of the murtis of Bhagwan Jagannath, Subhadraji and Baldevji. Swamishri offered pujan to the murtis with garlands, flowers and shawls. Swamishri also offered a bouquet of fruits and sweets for the deities. The Mahant honored Swamishri with a garland, shawl and prasad. Thereafter Swamishri went to the adjacent shrines and performed pujan of the murtis of Shri Narsinh Bhagwan, Tirupatiji, Ranchhodraiji and Dattatrey. In his blessings to the assembly Swamishri said, "It brings me great joy to have done the darshan of the deities on the festival of rath yatra. The murtis were brought from Jagannath and installed here. By having darshan one feels peaceful and he protects all his devotees. Narsinhdasji Maharaj, the former guru, was a great saint. The present Maharaj Pujya Rameshwardasji has spread the glory of Bhagwan Jagannath..." Swamishri performed a pradakshina of the deities and then went for darshan of Shri Hanumanji, Radha Krishna Dev, Laxmiji and Sita Ram installed in the shrine to the right of the main sanctum. After blessing the trustees Swamishri departed.
In the evening assembly balaks, kishores and youths performed the drama ' Brahmanand Darshan', which showed a few incidents from the life of Brahmanand Swami.

Evening Programs Devotees from all over the Southeast region gathered in the Orange County Convention Center in Orlando to offer their respects and devotion to Guruhari Pramukh Swami Maharaj on the celebration of Guru Purnima.

In this special assembly, sadhus sang the glory of Guruhari Pramukh Swami Maharaj through the verse, “Shobho sãdhu gune sadã saral ne…” Sadhus took turns explaining different parts of the verse, describing different virtues Swamishri possesses, including his detachment from the world, simplicity, and vast knowledge. Kishores also presented Swamishri’s qualities through dramas and lively dances. They gave Shri Harikrishna Maharaj and Swamishri a grand welcome on a dharmarath into the assembly.

Following this, Swamishri was greeted by the Mayor of Orlando, Buddy Dyer, as well as a Commissioner of Orange County, Homer Hartate. Swamishri blessed the assembly, describing the qualities of a true guru as explained in the Hindu scriptures. At the conclusion of the assembly, all devotees were given a divo to perform arti of Shri Harikrishna Maharaj and Swamishri.

Swamishri first visited Houston in 1977 and launched satsang. Today the tricennial celebration of Houston Satsang was arranged. The Mayor of Irving City (near Dallas) Mayor Herbert Gears honoured Swamishri and presented a proclamation and Key to the City. Thereafter Swamishri performed the murti-pratishtha rituals of pujan and arti of three hari mandirs: Little Rock (Arkansas), Austin (Texas) and San Antonio. In the afternoon a Women’s Convention was held. The chief guest was Texas State Representative Linda Harper Brown who presented a Resolution to commemorate the BAPS Centenary Year Celebration.

The evening tricennial celebration programme portrayed three decades of Swamishri’s effort in establishing and fostering Satsang. The first decade portrayed Swamishri’s colossal effort through home visits and personal contact. The second decade showed Swamishri’s profound love in fostering Satsang and the final decade reflected the transformations he has inspired. The entire programme was interspersed with speeches and cultural programmes. Krishnaprem Swami and Anandswarup Swami spoke on how Swamishri transforms the lives of people. In conclusion Swamishri blessed the assembly, “By the grace and glory of Bhagwan Swaminarayan we have been blessed with spiritual knowledge. And in his tradition of Gunatit disciples Shastriji Maharaj and Yogiji Maharaj have explained to us the principle of Akshar and Purushottam. Also, they have inspired us with the virtues of dharma, gnan, vairagya and bhakti, and guided us on how to eradicate base nature, addictions and bad habits.”
